content.rendered:
Transforming Sherwood High School into a Newly Unified Middle School

In May 2018, our Transformation Visioning Advisory Committee met in a series of four meetings to begin exploring possibilities and ideas for the transition of our existing Sherwood High School location into a single middle school.  Please see links below for information and presentations from those meetings.

Transformation Visioning Advisory Committee

May 3, 2018

May 17, 2018

May 24, 2018

May 31, 2018

June 7, 2018

In September 2018, our Building Design Committee began meeting to discuss the guiding principles that would inform the design process for this transformation.  Please see links below for content from our Building Design Committee meetings.

September 24, 2018

October 1 2018
